Andhra Pradesh.name: Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva (Integrated with AB-PMJAY)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare for catastrophic illnesses.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Annual family income < ₹5 Lakh, Rice Card / White Ration Card holder in AP.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: Up to ₹25 Lakh per family per year for 3,257+ medical/surgical procedures.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Visit empanelled hospital. 2. Approach Vaidya Mitra desk. 3. Provide Aadhaar/Ration card for biometric authentication. 4. Hospital submits pre-authorization.

Andhra Pradesh.name: Aarogya Aasara
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Post-operative sustenance allowance to prevent wage loss during recovery.
Andhra Pradesh.beneficiaries: Adults and Senior Citizens recovering from surgery.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Patients undergoing prescribed surgeries under Dr. NTR Vaidya Seva.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: ₹225 per day (up to ₹5,000/month) for the prescribed resting period.
Andhra Pradesh.documents: Hospital Discharge Summary, Bank Passbook, Aadhaar.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. At hospital discharge, Vaidya Mitra collects bank details. 2. Doctor certifies rest period. 3. Amount is credited directly to the bank account via DBT.

Andhra Pradesh.name: NTR Bharosa Pension (Health)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Financial pension for patients with severe chronic diseases/disabilities.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: BPL resident of AP, medically certified with severe chronic illness or >40% disability.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: ₹3,000 to ₹10,000 per month (₹10k for chronic renal failure/dialysis patients).
Andhra Pradesh.documents: Aadhaar, Medical Board Certificate (SADAREM), Rice Card, Bank Details.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Obtain SADAREM/Medical certificate. 2. Apply via Gram/Ward Sachivalayam. 3. Pension disbursed monthly at doorstep by volunteers.

Andhra Pradesh.name: PMMVY (Central)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Maternity benefit scheme for wage loss compensation and nutrition.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Income < ₹8 Lakh/yr or BPL/SC/ST. First live birth (and 2nd if girl child).
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: ₹5,000 for 1st child; ₹6,000 for 2nd girl child via DBT.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Register pregnancy at Anganwadi/PHC. 2. Fill Form 1-A. 3. Submit ANC/vaccination proofs for installments.

Andhra Pradesh.name: RBSK (Central)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Early screening and free surgical intervention for children (4Ds).
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: All children born in Govt hospitals, at Anganwadis, or in Govt schools.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: 100% free screening and surgeries for 30+ conditions (e.g., Congenital Heart Disease).
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Mobile Health Teams screen at Anganwadi/Schools. 2. Referred to District Early Intervention Centre (DEIC) for free surgery.

Andhra Pradesh.name: AB-Vay Vandana Card (Central)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Universal cashless health insurance for senior citizens.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 70 or above. No income limit.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: ₹5 Lakh per year on a family floater basis for 70+ members.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Download Ayushman App. 2. Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar Face/OTP. 3. Download card. 4. Use at empanelled hospitals.

Andhra Pradesh.name: Dr. NTR Vaidya Pariksha
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Free laboratory and diagnostic services at government hospitals.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Patients visiting Government PHCs, CHCs, and District Hospitals in AP.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: Free tests (e.g., blood, urine, biochemistry, X-ray) as per the facility level.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Visit Govt Hospital. 2. Doctor prescribes test. 3. Sample collected at the in-house lab. 4. Free report generated.

Andhra Pradesh.name: Talli Bidda Express (102)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Free dedicated transport service for pregnant women after delivery.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Women who deliver in Government Hospitals in Andhra Pradesh.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: Free drop-back transport from the hospital to home after childbirth/sterilization.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. After delivery at Govt Hospital, hospital staff books the 102 vehicle. 2. Vehicle drops mother and baby safely at home.

Andhra Pradesh.name: YSR Sampoorna Poshana
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Provide supplementary nutrition to pregnant/lactating mothers and children.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: Enrolled at local Anganwadi centres in Andhra Pradesh.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: Daily hot milk, eggs, and nutritious meals; take-home rations.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Register at local Anganwadi. 2. Attend daily for hot meals or collect take-home ration monthly.

Andhra Pradesh.name: PMBJP (Jan Aushadhi) (Central)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Provide quality generic medicines at affordable prices.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: 50% to 90% savings on medicine costs compared to branded medicines.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Visit nearest Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra. 2. Show prescription and purchase low-cost generic drugs.

Andhra Pradesh.name: SUMAN (Central)
Andhra Pradesh.purpose: Surakshit Matritva Aashwasan to ensure zero preventable maternal and newborn deaths.
Andhra Pradesh.eligibility: All pregnant women visiting public health facilities.
Andhra Pradesh.benefits: 100% free and quality antenatal, intra-partum, and post-partum care; zero denial of services.
Andhra Pradesh.howToApply: 1. Visit any Govt health facility. 2. Guaranteed free care and emergency management without referral drops.

Telangana.name: Rajiv Aarogyasri (Integrated with AB-PMJAY)
Telangana.purpose: Cashless inpatient care for serious diseases and surgeries.
Telangana.eligibility: Food Security Card (White Ration Card) holders in Telangana.
Telangana.benefits: Up to ₹10 Lakh per family per year for 1,672 procedures.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Visit Govt or network private hospital. 2. Meet Aarogya Mithra. 3. Biometric verification. 4. Cashless surgery upon approval.

Telangana.name: MCH Kit Scheme (formerly KCR Kit)
Telangana.purpose: Maternity assistance to encourage institutional deliveries.
Telangana.eligibility: Delivery must occur in a Telangana Government Hospital. Max 2 deliveries.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Register with ANM at PHC before 12 weeks. 2. Deliver at Govt hospital. 3. Installments linked to ANC & vaccines.

Telangana.name: Kanti Velugu
Telangana.purpose: Universal free eye screening and vision care.
Telangana.eligibility: All residents of Telangana, regardless of income.
Telangana.benefits: Free eye checkups, free reading/prescription glasses, and free cataract surgeries.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Attend local Kanti Velugu medical camp. 2. Undergo screening. 3. Receive reading glasses instantly or prescription glasses later via ASHA.

Telangana.name: Telangana Diagnostics
Telangana.purpose: Hub-and-spoke model for free pathology and radiology testing.
Telangana.eligibility: Patients referred by Government PHCs, CHCs, or Basti Dawakhanas.
Telangana.benefits: 134 free diagnostic tests (including Thyroid, Lipid, X-Ray, ECG).
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Visit Govt clinic/Basti Dawakhana. 2. Doctor prescribes tests. 3. Samples collected onsite and sent to Central Hub. 4. SMS report sent.

Telangana.name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (Central)
Telangana.eligibility: Any notified TB patient taking treatment. No income limit.
Telangana.benefits: ₹1,000 per month via DBT for the duration of TB treatment + Free drugs.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Get diagnosed at Govt/Private clinic. 2. Register on Ni-kshay portal. 3. Submit bank details to TB Health Visitor.

Telangana.name: JSSK (Central)
Telangana.purpose: Zero-expense delivery and sick infant care.
Telangana.beneficiaries: Pregnant Women, Sick Infants (up to 1 yr).
Telangana.benefits: 100% free delivery, drugs, tests, diet, blood, and 108/102 drop-back transport.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Call 108/102 for free ambulance. 2. Go to Govt hospital. 3. All services provided entirely free of cost.

Telangana.name: Arogya Lakshmi
Telangana.purpose: Ensure adequate nutrition for pregnant/lactating women and children.
Telangana.eligibility: Registered with Anganwadi centres in Telangana.
Telangana.benefits: One full nutritious meal daily (rice, dal, vegetables, egg, milk) for 300 days.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Enroll at the nearest Anganwadi centre. 2. Visit daily to consume the hot meal.

Telangana.name: Basti Dawakhana & Palle Dawakhana
Telangana.purpose: Provide comprehensive primary healthcare services in urban slums and rural areas.
Telangana.eligibility: Residents of urban slums and rural villages in Telangana.
Telangana.benefits: Free OPD consultation, basic lab tests, and free medicines.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Walk into the nearest Basti Dawakhana (urban) or Palle Dawakhana (rural). 2. Consult doctor and get free medicines.

Telangana.name: Aarogya Mahila
Telangana.purpose: Dedicated comprehensive health program exclusively for women.
Telangana.benefits: Free diagnostics, cancer screening (breast/cervical), PCOS treatment, menopause care on Tuesdays.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Visit designated Govt health centres on Tuesdays. 2. Exclusive female staff conduct screenings and treatment.

Telangana.name: Mission Indradhanush (UIP) (Central)
Telangana.purpose: Universal Immunization Programme to protect against vaccine-preventable diseases.
Telangana.benefits: 100% free vaccination for Polio, TB, DPT, Hepatitis B, Measles, Rubella, Rotavirus, etc.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Visit nearest Govt Hospital, PHC, or Anganwadi during Village Health Nutrition Day (VHND). 2. Get vaccinated.

Telangana.name: NPHCE (Central)
Telangana.purpose: National Programme for Health Care of the Elderly.
Telangana.eligibility: Any senior citizen seeking care at public health facilities.
Telangana.benefits: Dedicated geriatric OPDs, separate queues, wards, and physiotherapy at District Hospitals/CHCs.
Telangana.howToApply: 1. Visit District Hospital or CHC. 2. Use the dedicated Geriatric OPD counter for consultation and physiotherapy.

Tamil Nadu.name: CMCHIS (with AB-PMJAY)
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Comprehensive health insurance for major illnesses.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Family income < ₹1,20,000/year, mapped to Smart Ration Card.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for 1,090+ procedures.
Tamil Nadu.documents: Smart Ration Card, Aadhaar, VAO Income Certificate.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Obtain VAO Income proof. 2. Enroll at District Collectorate Kiosk for Smart Card. 3. Present at empanelled hospital Liaison Officer.

Tamil Nadu.name: Dr. Muthulakshmi Reddy Maternity Scheme
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Register pregnancy before 12 weeks. Delivery in Govt institution.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: ₹18,000 total (₹14,000 DBT cash + 2 Amma Nutrition Kits worth ₹4,000).
Tamil Nadu.documents: Aadhaar, PICME Number, Smart Ration Card, Bank Book.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Register with VHN online/offline to get PICME ID. 2. Receive kits at 3rd/4th month. 3. Cash installments post-delivery and vaccination.

Tamil Nadu.name: Makkalai Thedi Maruthuvam
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Doorstep NCD screening and home medicine delivery.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: All TN residents > 30 years with Hypertension/Diabetes, or Palliative care needs.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Free monthly home delivery of BP/Sugar drugs, physiotherapy, and dialysis bags.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Women Health Volunteers visit homes for screening. 2. Diagnosed patients added to registry. 3. Drugs delivered home monthly.

Tamil Nadu.name: Innuyir Kaappom (IKNK-48)
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Cashless emergency care for road accident victims.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Any person (including non-residents) injured in a road crash within TN limits.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Cashless trauma care for the first 48 hours up to ₹2 Lakh at 600+ hospitals.
Tamil Nadu.documents: Basic ID (post-stabilization). No ID required for admission.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Victim rushed to empanelled Govt/Private hospital. 2. Free treatment starts instantly without initial documentation.

Tamil Nadu.name: Tele-MANAS (Central)
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Anyone experiencing mental distress or psychiatric illness.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Free counselling, tele-psychiatry, and referral to District Mental Health clinics.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Dial 14416. 2. Select Tamil. 3. Speak to counsellor. 4. Escalate to psychiatrist if required.

Tamil Nadu.name: Chief Minister's Newborn Care Kit
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Provide essential items for maternal and newborn hygiene.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: Women delivering in Government Hospitals in Tamil Nadu.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: A kit containing 16 essential items (baby towel, dress, soap, oil, nail clipper, mother's health mix, etc.).
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Deliver baby at Govt Hospital. 2. Kit is handed over at the time of hospital discharge.

Tamil Nadu.name: Varumun Kappom Thittam
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Preventive multi-specialty medical camps at the village level.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: All residents attending the designated camps.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Free specialist consultation (cardio, ortho, gynae), ECG, ultrasound, blood tests, and medicines.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Check local announcements for camp dates. 2. Walk into the camp for full body screening and treatment.

Tamil Nadu.name: TN Differently Abled Welfare Scheme
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Monthly maintenance allowance and early intervention.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹1,500 - ₹2,000, free assistive devices, and Early Intervention Centre therapy.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Register at District Differently Abled Welfare Office (DDAWO) or online. 2. Pension credited via DBT.

Tamil Nadu.name: PMSMA (Central)
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Free high-risk pregnancy screening on the 9th of every month.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Free ultrasound, hemoglobin, BP, and specialist obstetric care by private/public doctors at Govt centres.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Visit Govt hospital/PHC on the 9th of the month. 2. Receive comprehensive antenatal checkup.

Tamil Nadu.name: Rashtriya Arogya Nidhi (Central)
Tamil Nadu.purpose: Financial aid for life-threatening diseases at Super-Specialty Hospitals.
Tamil Nadu.eligibility: BPL patients seeking treatment for cancer, organ transplant, etc., at Govt Super-Specialty/RCC.
Tamil Nadu.benefits: Financial grant up to ₹15 Lakh directly to the treating hospital.
Tamil Nadu.documents: BPL Ration Card, Doctor's Estimate, Income Proof.
Tamil Nadu.howToApply: 1. Get clinical estimate from treating HOD at Govt hospital. 2. Submit via Hospital Social Worker to Health Ministry.

Karnataka.name: AB-Arogya Karnataka (AB-ArK)
Karnataka.purpose: Universal Health Coverage for both BPL and APL families.
Karnataka.eligibility: BPL (PHH/AAY card) get 100% free. APL get 30% Govt co-pay.
Karnataka.benefits: BPL: ₹5 Lakh/year. APL: 30% Govt reimbursement up to ₹1.5 Lakh.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Get AB-ArK card at BangaloreOne/Govt Hospital. 2. Visit Govt hospital. 3. If treatment unavailable, get SAST referral to private hospital.
Karnataka.fees: Free for BPL; Co-pay for APL

Karnataka.name: Gruha Arogya
Karnataka.purpose: Doorstep health screening and free medicine distribution.
Karnataka.eligibility: All citizens in Karnataka above 30 years.
Karnataka.benefits: Free screening for 6 NCDs (Diabetes, BP, Cancer) and free doorstep drug delivery.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Health staff visit households. 2. Conduct screening. 3. Dispense a 30-day supply of medicines at home.

Karnataka.name: Mathrupoorna Yojana
Karnataka.purpose: Nutritional support to prevent maternal anemia/malnutrition.
Karnataka.eligibility: Rural pregnant and lactating women registered at local Anganwadi.
Karnataka.benefits: One full hot cooked nutritious meal daily for 300 days at the Anganwadi center.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Register with local Anganwadi worker. 2. Visit center daily to consume the hot meal.

Karnataka.name: Mukhyamantri Santwana Harish
Karnataka.purpose: Free immediate trauma care for road accident victims.
Karnataka.eligibility: Any road crash victim within Karnataka borders.
Karnataka.benefits: Up to ₹25,000 cashless treatment for the first 48 hours.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Take victim to nearest empanelled hospital. 2. Hospital logs case on SAST portal for immediate cashless care.

Karnataka.name: PMNDP (Central)
Karnataka.purpose: Free dialysis services for chronic kidney patients.
Karnataka.eligibility: BPL patients suffering from end-stage renal disease.
Karnataka.benefits: 100% free haemodialysis/peritoneal dialysis at Govt district hospitals.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Get diagnosed by Govt doctor. 2. Register at District Hospital Dialysis unit. 3. Receive free scheduled dialysis.

Karnataka.name: JSY (Central)
Karnataka.eligibility: Delivering in Govt hospital. BPL/SC/ST status applies.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Register pregnancy. 2. Deliver in Govt hospital. 3. Medical Officer processes DBT payment.

Karnataka.name: Yeshasvini Cooperative Farmers Health Scheme
Karnataka.purpose: Cashless surgical healthcare for farmers in cooperative societies.
Karnataka.eligibility: Members of rural cooperative societies in Karnataka for at least 3 months.
Karnataka.benefits: Up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year for 823 surgical procedures at network hospitals.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Pay annual premium at the cooperative society. 2. Present card at empanelled hospital for cashless surgery.

Karnataka.name: Jyothi Sanjeevini Scheme (JSS)
Karnataka.purpose: Cashless tertiary healthcare for state government employees.
Karnataka.eligibility: Serving Karnataka State Government employees (not pensioners).
Karnataka.benefits: Cashless treatment for 7 broad specialties (cardio, oncology, neuro, renal, burns, poly-trauma, neonatology).
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Visit SAST empanelled network hospital. 2. Provide KGID for authentication. 3. Avail cashless care.

Karnataka.name: Namma Clinic
Karnataka.purpose: Urban primary health care clinics delivering essential services.
Karnataka.eligibility: Residents of urban local bodies and BBMP areas.
Karnataka.benefits: Free OPD, 14 lab tests, tele-consultation, and free medicines.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Walk into the local Namma Clinic. 2. Consult the doctor and receive treatment/medicines.

Karnataka.name: Shuchi Scheme
Karnataka.purpose: Menstrual hygiene management for adolescent girls.
Karnataka.eligibility: Girls studying in Government and Government-aided schools/colleges.
Karnataka.benefits: Free distribution of sanitary napkin kits.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Enrolled in Govt school. 2. Kits distributed directly by the school nodal teacher/health worker.

Karnataka.name: RKSK (Central)
Karnataka.purpose: Adolescent friendly health clinics and WIFS.
Karnataka.benefits: Weekly Iron Folic Acid Supplementation (WIFS), counselling on nutrition, reproductive health, and mental health.
Karnataka.howToApply: 1. Visit Adolescent Friendly Health Clinic (AFHC) at Govt hospital or receive WIFS at school/Anganwadi.

Kerala.name: Karunya Arogya Suraksha Padhathi (KASP)
Kerala.purpose: Cashless secondary and tertiary healthcare coverage.
Kerala.eligibility: Families in SECC list, AAY/Pink ration cards, and specific state categories.
Kerala.benefits: Up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year across 600+ network hospitals.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Verify via Akshaya centre. 2. Go to empanelled hospital KASP desk. 3. Provide Aadhaar for biometric match. 4. Cashless treatment.

Kerala.name: Hridyam
Kerala.purpose: Comprehensive care for paediatric congenital heart disease.
Kerala.eligibility: Any child residing in Kerala diagnosed with CHD. Universal coverage (APL/BPL).
Kerala.benefits: 100% free emergency transport, heart surgeries, ICU care, and follow-ups.
Kerala.documents: Child's Birth ID, Parent's Aadhaar, Echo report.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Register on Hridyam portal. 2. Upload Echo. 3. Medical panel assigns empanelled hospital. 4. Free surgery provided.

Kerala.name: Arogyakiranam
Kerala.purpose: Universal free treatment for all children.
Kerala.eligibility: All children under 18 seeking care in Kerala Govt hospitals.
Kerala.benefits: Free consultation, diagnostics, and medicines for any illness.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Visit any Govt Hospital/Medical College. 2. Show child's age proof. 3. All OPD and IPD charges are waived.

Kerala.name: Vayomithram
Kerala.purpose: Mobile geriatric healthcare and palliative support.
Kerala.benefits: Free mobile clinic checkups, free medicines, and palliative home care.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Register with local municipal ward councilor or Vayomithram coordinator. 2. Attend mobile clinic in ward.

Kerala.name: Thalolam
Kerala.purpose: Tertiary care funding for severe childhood diseases.
Kerala.eligibility: Families unable to afford treatment for kidney, heart, neuro, or cancer issues.
Kerala.benefits: Free treatment up to ₹50,000 (can be enhanced via superintendent approval).
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Approach Govt Medical College MS office. 2. Submit doctor's estimate. 3. Hospital committee approves free care.

Kerala.name: ADIP Scheme (Central)
Kerala.purpose: Free assistive aids and appliances for PwDs.
Kerala.benefits: Free wheelchairs, hearing aids, prosthetics, and smart canes.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Register on ALIMCO portal. 2. Attend district assessment camp. 3. Receive customized aid for free.

Kerala.name: Karunya Benevolent Fund (KBF)
Kerala.purpose: Financial assistance for catastrophic illnesses for those not in KASP.
Kerala.eligibility: Families with annual income < ₹3 Lakh not covered under KASP.
Kerala.benefits: Up to ₹2 Lakh - ₹3 Lakh for cancer, hemophilia, kidney/heart diseases, and palliative care.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Apply via treating hospital's Karunya portal. 2. Get estimate approved by State Health Agency.

Kerala.name: Sukrutham
Kerala.purpose: Free cancer treatment for patients in Kerala.
Kerala.benefits: Free chemotherapy, radiation, and cancer surgeries at Regional Cancer Centres and Govt Medical Colleges.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Visit Govt Medical College or RCC. 2. Enroll in Sukrutham with Ration Card. 3. Free treatment begins.

Kerala.name: Sruthitharangam
Kerala.purpose: Free cochlear implantation scheme for deaf children.
Kerala.eligibility: Children with severe-to-profound hearing loss in Kerala. Income < ₹2 Lakh.
Kerala.benefits: 100% free cochlear implant surgery + 2 years of auditory verbal therapy.
Kerala.documents: Aadhaar, Income Certificate, BERA test report.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Apply via Kerala Social Security Mission (KSSM) portal. 2. Approved by state medical board. 3. Free surgery at empanelled hospital.

Kerala.name: Aswasakiranam
Kerala.purpose: Financial assistance to caregivers of bedridden patients.
Kerala.eligibility: Caregivers of patients with severe mental/physical disability, cancer, or bedridden (BPL).
Kerala.benefits: Monthly pension of ₹600 directly to the caregiver's bank account.
Kerala.documents: Medical Certificate, Aadhaar, BPL Ration Card.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Apply online at KSSM portal with medical certificate. 2. Verification by ICDS/medical officer. 3. DBT initiated.

Kerala.name: AMRIT Pharmacies (Central)
Kerala.purpose: Affordable medicines and reliable implants for treatment.
Kerala.eligibility: Any patient with a valid prescription.
Kerala.benefits: Heavy discounts (up to 60-70%) on cancer drugs, cardiac stents, and orthopedic implants.
Kerala.howToApply: 1. Go to AMRIT pharmacy located inside Govt Medical Colleges/Hospitals. 2. Purchase medicines at discounted rates.
